WITH matching_posts AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Title
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
),
link_endpoints AS (
    SELECT l.PostId AS post_id, l.RelatedPostId AS other_id, 'post' AS endpoint
    FROM postLinks AS l
    JOIN matching_posts AS p ON p.Id = l.PostId
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l.RelatedPostId AS post_id, l.PostId AS other_id, 'related' AS endpoint
    FROM postLinks AS l
    JOIN matching_posts AS p ON p.Id = l.RelatedPostId
)
SELECT p.Id, p.Title,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN l.endpoint = 'post' THEN 1 END) AS post_link_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.endpoint = 'post' THEN l.other_id END) AS post_neighbors,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.endpoint = 'related' THEN l.other_id END) AS related_neighbors,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.other_id) AS total_neighbors,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN l.other_id = p.Id THEN 1 END) AS self_links,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN l.other_id IS NOT NULL AND other.Id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_posts
FROM matching_posts AS p
LEFT JOIN link_endpoints AS l ON l.post_id = p.Id
LEFT JOIN posts AS other ON other.Id = l.other_id
GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title
ORDER BY p.Id

arguments.sql:
WITH matching_posts AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Title
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
),
linked_posts AS (
    SELECT l.PostId AS post_id, l.RelatedPostId AS related_post_id
    FROM postLinks AS l
    JOIN matching_posts AS p ON p.Id = l.PostId
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l.RelatedPostId AS post_id, l.PostId AS related_post_id
    FROM postLinks AS l
    JOIN matching_posts AS p ON p.Id = l.RelatedPostId
),
related_counts AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Title, COUNT(DISTINCT l.related_post_id) AS related_post_count
    FROM matching_posts AS p
    LEFT JOIN linked_posts AS l
        ON l.post_id = p.Id AND l.related_post_id <> p.Id
    GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title
)
SELECT c.Title, c.related_post_count
FROM related_counts AS c
WHERE c.related_post_count = (SELECT MAX(related_post_count) FROM related_counts)
ORDER BY c.Title, c.Id
LIMIT -1
